svg.title: Automated Azure AD token refresh for Grafana PostgreSQL data sources
svg.desc: Azure service principal authenticates with Entra ID. A Kubernetes pod has an init container, Grafana main container, and token-refresher sidecar. Init discovers databases and writes data source YAML to shared EmptyDir. The sidecar refreshes tokens every 45 minutes, updates a Kubernetes secret and updates Grafana data source passwords through its REST API. External Secrets, service-principal credentials, RBAC and a service account support the workflow.

g.text: Azure AD / Entra ID · Dynamic PostgreSQL discovery · Kubernetes init + main + sidecar
06 Grafana REST API → update data source passwords
